intro: This Privacy Policy describes how ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD ('Company,' 'we,' 'us,' or 'our'), a private limited company registered in England and Wales (Company Number: 17474730; Registered Office: Office 1878 85 Dunstall Hill, Wolverhampton, WV6 0SR, United Kingdom), collects, uses, discloses, and safeguards information obtained from clients, prospective clients, and visitors to our website. By accessing our website or engaging our services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information in two primary ways: (1) information you provide directly to us, and (2) information collected automatically when you interact with our website or services. Directly provided information may include your full name, business name, email address, phone number, mailing and billing addresses, tax identification numbers, shipment details (including consignee names and destination addresses), and any other information you submit through contact forms, inquiry submissions, or service agreements. Payment and billing information associated with customer transactions is also collected. Where card payments are available, full payment-card information is processed by authorised payment processors and is not stored by ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD on its own servers. Automatically collected information may include IP addresses, browser type and version, operating system, referring URLs, pages visited, time spent on pages, and device identifiers.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect for the following purposes: (a) to provide, operate, and improve our custom product procurement, order fulfillment, shipment coordination, and related customer services; (b) to process payments and manage billing; (c) to communicate with you regarding your orders, shipments, order and payment status, and support requests; (d) to comply with applicable legal obligations, including customs, export control, sanctions, and anti-money-laundering regulations; (e) to detect, prevent, and investigate fraud, security incidents, or other prohibited activities; (f) to send transactional and service-related communications; (g) to analyse usage trends and improve our website and service offerings; and (h) to enforce our Terms of Service and other agreements.

sections.heading: Legal Bases for Processing (UK GDPR / GDPR)
sections.body: For individuals located in the United Kingdom or the European Economic Area (EEA), we process personal data under the following legal bases: (a) Performance of a Contract — processing is necessary to fulfil our service obligations to you; (b) Legal Obligation — processing is required to comply with applicable laws and regulations; (c) Legitimate Interests — processing is necessary for our legitimate business interests, such as fraud prevention and service improvement, provided those interests are not overridden by your rights; and (d) Consent — where we have obtained your explicit consent for specific processing activities, such as marketing communications. You may withdraw consent at any time by contacting us at support@arseenenterprises.co.uk.

sections.heading: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
sections.body: Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyse site traffic, and support certain website functions. Cookies are small text files stored on your device. We use the following categories of cookies: (a) Strictly Necessary Cookies, which are required for the website to function and cannot be disabled; (b) Analytics Cookies, which help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting and reporting information anonymously; and (c) Preference Cookies, which allow the website to remember choices you make. You may control cookie settings through your browser preferences. Disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our website.

sections.heading: Third-Party Sharing and Disclosure
sections.body: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for their own marketing purposes. We may share your information with trusted third parties only in the following circumstances: (a) Service Providers — we engage third-party vendors to assist with payment processing, shipping carriers, customs brokers, cloud hosting, and analytics. These parties are contractually obligated to protect your information and use it only for the purposes we specify; (b) Legal Compliance — we may disclose information when required by law, court order, or governmental authority, including customs and border protection agencies; (c) Business Transfers — in the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction, subject to equivalent privacy protections; and (d) Protection of Rights — we may disclose information to protect the rights, property, or safety of ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD, our clients, or others.

sections.heading: International Data Transfers
sections.body: As a company providing custom product procurement and international order fulfillment services, we operate across multiple jurisdictions. Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries outside your country of residence, including the United Kingdom and other countries, which may have different data protection laws. Where we transfer personal data outside the UK or EEA, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place in accordance with applicable data protection law.

sections.heading: Data Storage and Security
sections.body: We implement reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Payment card information is processed through our payment processors and is not stored on our servers. While we take reasonable precautions, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. In the event of a data breach that affects your rights and freedoms, we will notify affected individuals and relevant authorities as required by applicable law, including the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) where required.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We retain personal information for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law. Specifically: (a) customer, order, transaction, invoice, and fulfillment records are retained for a minimum of seven (7) years to comply with tax, accounting, and customs recordkeeping requirements; (b) shipment and fulfillment records may be retained longer where required by international trade regulations; (c) marketing consent records are retained until consent is withdrawn plus an additional three (3) years; and (d) website analytics data is retained in aggregated, anonymised form. When personal information is no longer needed, we securely delete or anonymise it.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information: (a) Right of Access — the right to request a copy of the personal information we hold about you; (b) Right to Rectification — the right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information; (c) Right to Erasure ('Right to Be Forgotten') — the right to request deletion of your personal information, subject to legal retention obligations; (d) Right to Restriction of Processing — the right to request that we limit how we use your information; (e) Right to Data Portability — the right to receive your information in a structured, machine-readable format; (f) Right to Object — the right to object to processing based on legitimate interests or for direct marketing; and (g) Right to Lodge a Complaint — UK residents have the right to lodge a complaint with the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at support@arseenenterprises.co.uk. We will respond to verified requests within 30 days (or within the timeframe required by applicable law).

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: Our services are available to both business clients and individual consumers. We do not knowingly collect personal information from individuals under the age of 18. If we become aware that we have inadvertently collected personal information from a minor, we will take prompt steps to delete such information. If you believe we may have collected information from a minor, please contact us immediately at support@arseenenterprises.co.uk.

sections.heading: Third-Party Links
sections.body: Our website may contain links to third-party websites, payment portals, or carrier tracking systems. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those third-party sites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party sites you visit.

sections.heading: Policy Updates
sections.body: We reserve the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy at any time to reflect changes in our practices, legal requirements, or business operations. When we make material changes, we will update the 'Last Updated' date at the top of this policy and, where appropriate, notify clients by email or through a prominent notice on our website. Your continued use of our services after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us. We are committed to resolving privacy-related concerns promptly and transparently.
